text: Re-read 2026-08-17. 'Via the STORE, never raw' still holds - read_all is handed the entity's current hashes, which is what lets it mark an entry stale, and viz never touches the jsonl directly. The excavated-marker paragraph is also still true and still matters: it is what lets a card say 'this describes code as of a commit' rather than implying it describes the code now.

text: Re-read at 0.56.2. Both comments still describe the body exactly: knowledge still comes through MetaStore.read_all with the entity's accepted hashes (which is what marks an entry stale), and the excavated markers are still carried so a card can say 'as of a commit' rather than implying now. The only change is that accepted_for and for_display now arrive from one module-level import instead of two lines inside this function - four scattered metadata imports in this file were how the render summary missed a rule three lines above it.
